svg.title: Binomial PMFs for n=4, p=0.5 and p=0.3
svg.desc: Two vertically stacked panels share a probability scale from zero to 0.5. For k from zero through four, the p=0.5 probabilities are 0.0625, 0.25, 0.375, 0.25, 0.0625. The p=0.3 probabilities are 0.2401, 0.4116, 0.2646, 0.0756, 0.0081. Each bar is labeled with its exact percentage.
